title: Snare drum
description: One snare drum through the unpitched percussion bridge: a dynamics ladder of hits (velocity on the pinned curve), accent, marcato, staccato and tenuto, eighths at one level, and tremolo rolls under a crescendo and at a fixed level (CC1 on the roll base). Every note arrives at the Natural or Tremolo code.
